fields.what_it_is: Tracking device. Image-guided neurosurgery (neuronavigation, "frameless stereotaxy") - operative technique by which correlation (co-registration) between imaging studies and operative field is provided. STEREOTACTIC NEUROSURGERY - use of coordinate system to provide accurate navigation to point / region in space (e.g. deep brain structures) without direct visualization.
fields.indications: 1. Tumor (biopsy, resection, radiosurgery). 2. Epilepsy (structural & physiologic data, resection). 3. Treatment of *functional abnormalities* (movement disorders, pain conditions) by lesioning or stimulation. 4. Stereotactic *implantations* of neural tissue, drug transplants, gene therapy. 5. Spine (instrumentation). 6. Ventricular catheterization (EVD / VP shunt placement).
fields.compatible_with: Following image types are supported by current software: CT, CTA, MR, MRA, fMRI, DTI • PET. Medtronic "Vertek". BrainLab "VarioGuide". Medtronic Unibody Bone Fiducials (models FM-4007 [7 mm], FM-4010 [10 mm], and FM-4013 [13 mm]). Stryker battery-powered screwdriver QuikDrive™ mini (catalog #62-50101). Screwdriver blades: #62-15001 – it is 1.7 mm #62-00537 – size?. OsteoMed hand-held screwdriver (#220-0019 and the blade #220-0061).
fields.use_notes: Co-registration is the fundamental principle of stereotaxy! "Stealth protocol": 1. 1-3 mm slice thickness. 2. Volumetric (3D) scan contiguous slices (e.g. T1 MPRAGE, CUBE FLAIR). 3. "Zero gantry" zero tilt not a requirement for modern navigation software 4. Request not to "cut" the nose and top of head. Obtain CD from radiology and upload to the navigation station the night before surgery: 1) correct patient. 2) correct study. Acceptable ≤ 0.3 mm (in DBS ≤ 0.2 mm).
